name: retyc
description: End-to-end encrypted file transfer and secure dataroom management
long_description:
Retyc exposes all its encrypted file transfer and dataroom operations as MCP tools. Files are encrypted locally before upload: plaintext never leaves your machine. Supports sending/receiving transfers, managing datarooms (create, upload, download, share), and user management with end-to-end encryption.

Authentication is handled directly from your MCP client: call `auth_login_start` to get a login URL, then `auth_login_poll` until done. No terminal required.

**Privacy**: the bundled binary runs the entire encryption layer locally and communicates exclusively with the Retyc API (api.retyc.com). File contents are encrypted before upload and decrypted straight to disk — they never appear in tool responses. Tool responses contain only metadata (filenames, sizes, IDs), which your MCP client shares with the model as part of normal operation.

key_passphrase.title: Encryption Key Passphrase
key_passphrase.description: Passphrase for your Retyc private key (minimum 8 characters). Required for all E2E encrypted operations: transfer_info, transfer_send, transfer_download, and all dataroom_* tools.

token.title: Retyc Token
token.description: Optional offline token to bypass the interactive login flow. Leave empty to authenticate via auth_login_start / auth_login_poll.
